headline: The cot price store (opal-data-cot silver/prices/canonical_prices.parquet) has FOUR production readers keyed by ticker alone (commonwealth_price_census.py:57, commonwealth_price_basis_census.py:364, commonwealth_bond_custodian_price.py:125, commonwealth_bd_txn_provenance.py:117-121); the ruling's expected zero is not met, so W158-S2 does not disarm on a zero read. The named readers (the builder, commonwealth_account_return_daily.py) do not read this key: the builder writes it and the ARD adapter reads the minted commonwealth/cottonwood tables only (:221-226). Six gold readers key by asset_name alone (not ticker) and one diag counts rows with no key (the record's keyed_other kind covers all seven non-ticker readers); the store also holds two asset_names under one ticker (ADVI_COTBKF-D2-W159-S1), which the asset_name readers keep apart.
